# Swiftgigs

> Swiftgigs is a WhatsApp-based platform that connects people across Nigeria with identity-verified local workers across 15 service categories, including cleaning, errands, home and appliance repairs, food orders, beauty, laundry, moving and delivery. There is no app to download: customers send one WhatsApp message, choose a verified worker nearby, agree the price in the chat, and pay through an escrow that is released when they confirm the job is done (or automatically after 3 hours if they do not respond). Disputes are reviewed by a customer care agent. Swiftgigs takes a 10% commission, capped at ₦10,000, from worker payouts.

Swiftgigs is currently pre-launch: worker onboarding and customer requests open soon, and a public waitlist is live. A closed beta with 20 testers has been completed, covering the full request, match and escrow flow. Beta feedback drove a key change: NIN-based identity verification, matched against the worker's payout bank account name, is now built in and runs at a worker's first job. Swiftgigs Technologies LTD is a CAC-registered Nigerian business.
